process BIGSCAPE_BIGSCAPE {
    tag "${meta.id}"
    label 'process_medium'

    conda "${moduleDir}/environment.yml"
    container "${workflow.containerEngine in ['singularity', 'apptainer'] && !task.ext.singularity_pull_docker_container
        ? 'https://community-cr-prod.seqera.io/docker/registry/v2/blobs/sha256/3d/3d0ff9770fe46787912573cedac2a2c1e39333e648a6f7060992d22851f88ae7/data'
        : 'community.wave.seqera.io/library/bigscape_sqlalchemy:d11ab34d38b34cb6'}"

    input:
    tuple val(meta), path(gbk_dir)
    path pfam_hmm

    output:
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}"), emit: output
    tuple val("${task.process}"), val('bigscape'), eval("bigscape --version | sed 's/BiG-SCAPE //'"), topic: versions, emit: versions_bigscape

    when:
    task.ext.when == null || task.ext.when

    script:
    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    def pfam_file = pfam_hmm.name.endsWith('.gz') ? pfam_hmm.baseName : pfam_hmm
    """
    if [[ "${pfam_hmm}" == *.gz ]]; then
        python -c "import gzip, shutil; shutil.copyfileobj(gzip.open('${pfam_hmm}', 'rb'), open('${pfam_file}', 'wb'))"
    fi

    bigscape cluster \\
        --gbk-dir ${gbk_dir} \\
        --pfam-path ${pfam_file} \\
        --output-dir ${prefix} \\
        --cores ${task.cpus} \\
        ${args}

    if [[ "${pfam_hmm}" == *.gz ]]; then
        rm -f ${pfam_file}
    fi
    """

    stub:
    prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    """
    mkdir -p ${prefix}/network_files
    touch ${prefix}/network_files/mix.network
    mkdir -p ${prefix}/html_content
    touch ${prefix}/html_content/index.html
    """
}

---
name: "nf-core/bigscape/bigscape"
description: "BiG-SCAPE (Biosynthetic Gene Similarity Clustering and Prospecting Engine)\
  \ clusters\nbiosynthetic gene clusters (BGCs) into gene cluster families (GCFs)\
  \ based on sequence\nsimilarity networks. It takes antiSMASH-annotated GenBank files\
  \ and a Pfam database as\ninput, and produces similarity networks and clustering\
  \ results.\n"
keywords:
- "biosynthetic gene clusters"
- "BGC"
- "clustering"
- "similarity network"
- "antiSMASH"
- "gene cluster families"
- "secondary metabolites"
- "natural products"
tools:
- bigscape:
    description: "Biosynthetic Gene Similarity Clustering and Prospecting Engine for\
      \ clustering BGCs into gene cluster families using similarity networks"
    homepage: "https://github.com/medema-group/BiG-SCAPE"
    documentation: "https://bigscape-corason.secondarymetabolites.org/BiG-SCAPE/"
    tool_dev_url: "https://github.com/medema-group/BiG-SCAPE"
    doi: "10.1038/s41589-019-0400-9"
    licence:
    - "AGPL v3-or-later"
    identifier: "biotools:BiG-SCAPE"
input:
- - meta:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
        \ ]`\n"
  - gbk_dir:
      type: "directory"
      description: "Directory containing antiSMASH-annotated GenBank (.gbk) files\
        \ representing\nbiosynthetic gene cluster regions. This is typically the output\
        \ directory from\nan antiSMASH run.\n"
      pattern: "*"
      ontologies: []
- pfam_hmm:
    type: "file"
    description: "Path to a Pfam HMM database file (e.g. Pfam-A.hmm or Pfam-A.hmm.gz).\n\
      BiG-SCAPE will run `hmmpress` if needed. Can be obtained from the\nPfam FTP\
      \ site.\n"
    pattern: "*.{hmm,hmm.gz}"
    ontologies: []
output:
  output:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information"
    - ${prefix}:
        type: "directory"
        description: "BiG-SCAPE output directory containing similarity network files,\n\
          clustering results, and HTML visualisation content.\n"
        pattern: "${prefix}"
  versions_bigscape:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - bigscape:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - bigscape --version | sed 's/BiG-SCAPE //':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
topics:
  versions:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
